cases.prompt: Turn this collection of MATLAB analysis scripts and workflow notes into a new LabKit App.
cases.rationale: Creating a complete App from scripts and workflow evidence is the core workflow.

cases.prompt: Reshape this legacy GUIDE GUI into the current Definition, layout, and App-owned state architecture.
cases.rationale: A substantial App architecture migration belongs to the App builder.

cases.prompt: Fix one callback that formats an existing status label incorrectly.
cases.rationale: A narrow behavior fix that preserves the App shape does not need the build workflow.

cases.prompt: Correct the valid humidity range in an existing thermal calculation without changing the App structure.
cases.rationale: This is a scientific contract correction, not an App construction task.

cases.prompt: Build a new image-analysis App with live parameter sliders, a Run action, progress reporting, and exports.
cases.rationale: A new App requires explicit input commit, refresh, progress, and logging design as part of the complete build workflow.

cases.prompt: Debounce one existing slider callback without changing the App architecture.
cases.rationale: A narrow interaction correction remains ordinary App maintenance unless it proves a larger App redesign.

cases.prompt: Build a static LabKit App showing a protocol reference, with no saved task or runtime data.
cases.rationale: App construction applies even when state, presentation callbacks, and persistence are unnecessary.
